specimens.name: Low-profile rectangular industrial pushbutton
specimens.notes: Compact rectangular low-profile industrial pushbutton with plain unlit cap and molded bezel; no text or integrated display.

specimens.name: Guarded red mushroom emergency-stop
specimens.notes: Red mushroom emergency-stop is isolated in a compact yellow industrial guard collar with physical reset hardware and no labels.

specimens.name: Detented rotary encoder knob
specimens.notes: Compact ribbed rotary encoder knob uses a standardized bezel and visibly stepped physical detent ring; the simple pointer stripe is not text/numbering and no printed scale or labels are present.

specimens.name: Sealed industrial rocker-switch module
specimens.notes: Single low-profile sealed dark rocker in a molded bezel, with no icon, text, lamp or surrounding panel.

specimens.name: Twelve-key membrane keypad module
specimens.notes: Exactly twelve equal blank key zones are arranged 3×4 in a compact beige/gray module; no legends, display or writing.

specimens.name: Industrial trackball pointing module
specimens.notes: Panel-mount trackball has one dark ball and exactly two blank physical buttons in a sealed bezel; no screen, keyboard or console.

specimens.name: Compact sealed two-axis joystick
specimens.notes: Short dark industrial joystick has molded grip, rubber bellows and compact square mounting bezel with no labels or lights.

specimens.name: Four-key soft-function key strip
specimens.notes: Narrow rack-console-style strip contains exactly four identical blank low-profile keys and no display, labels or LEDs.

review_method: Exact untouched PNG visually inspected against the merged E2 operator-controls machine spec, approved E1 controls lineage and canonical style bible. Local SHA-256, dimensions and byte count were verified; Google Drive metadata confirms the same byte count in the canonical E2_1998 raw folder before acceptance.
